areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective aligned; drainage and mobility component with suitable indicators, relevant resources; moderate impact from a limited beneficiary population.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Linear park revitalization, vegetation recovery, nature-based solutions and sewage-discharge elimination targets; relevant resources; moderate impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Objective on flooding reduction and canal requalification, but channelization and drainage alone have limited impact on risk management and adaptation.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Avenue requalification for tourist connectivity with visitor-flow indicator, but road and signage works do not raise quality or value of tourism services.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: General objective unrelated; lighting, video monitoring and a women's sports centre are fragmented and not tied to the violence indicator.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: No related specific objectives, indicators or targets; outdoor gyms and cycle paths receive few resources and have little impact.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Electromobility and solar plant mentioned in justification, but no matching actions, indicators or resource allocation.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Training and maintenance planning only; indicators are output-based and the impact is limited.
